title: Information Visualization
description: An introduction to visualization, or the use of interactive visual representations of data to support human cognition. Principles of visualization design are presented from a human perceptual and cognitive standpoint. Topics include: design, interaction, perception and cognition, evaluation and applications.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of CSC 511, CSC 411, CSC 485D (if taken in the same topic), SENG 480D (if taken in the same topic).
May be offered as a joint undergraduate and graduate class.
